content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Release Date: 03.08.2026 Last Date to Apply Online: 31.08.2026 The official notice does not mention a separate application start date, exam date, or interview date. content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 9 vacancies are available across 7 posts – 1 for Librarian, 1 for Deputy Librarian, 1 for Assistant Registrar, 1 for Assistant Engineer (Electrical), 1 for Senior Assistant, 2 for Library Assistant, and 2 for Assistant. No category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) reservation breakup has been mentioned in the official notice.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. Minimum 9 years' experience as Assistant Librarian / Deputy Librarian / Additional Librarian in a University, College, or Indian/Foreign Research Institution, of which at least 3 years must be at Deputy Librarian/Additional Librarian level. Evidence of innovative library services, including integration of ICT in a library. Ph.D. in Library Science / Documentation / Archives and Manuscript Keeping. Master's Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. 8 years' experience as Assistant University Librarian / College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. Ph.D. in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science / Archives and Manuscript Keeping / Computerization of Library. Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent, with a good academic record. Minimum 5 years' professional experience in a university/educational/research institution, or equivalent administrative experience in areas such as admission, examination, establishment, procurement, HR/welfare, legal, or estate management. Exceptional English speaking skills and ability to work with a culturally diverse population. Desirable: Additional qualification in Management/Law; experience handling General Financial Rules; basic computer knowledge. Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. At least 2 years' post-qualification experience as a Junior Engineer or similar role in a government body or reputed commercial establishment. Exceptional English speaking skills and ability to interact with a diverse population. Desirable: Experience with electrical installations, meters, pumps, lighting, AC units, geysers; knowledge of Contract Law, CPWD/PWD accounting procedures. Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 5 years' experience in Administration, Establishment, Academic, Finance & Accounts, or General Supervision/Management. Proficiency in computer operation, noting, and drafting. Master's Degree in Library & Information Science with 2 years' relevant experience in a University/Research establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/autonomous institution library, OR Bachelor's Degree in Library/Library and Information Science with 3 years' relevant experience in a similar institution. Knowledge of computer applications required. Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 3 years' experience in Administration, Establishment, Academic, Finance & Accounts, or General Supervision/Management. Proficiency in computer operation, noting, and drafting.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Pay scales are fixed in USD per annum, along with admissible allowances, and vary by post - ranging from USD 6,000-11,000 per annum for Assistant/Library Assistant up to USD 30,000-45,000 per annum for the post of Librarian. Refer to the vacancy table above for post-wise pay scale.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee: Rs. 500/- for each post , to be paid online directly to the University's bank account. The UTR Number / Transaction Reference Number must be mentioned in the application form. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, and pay the fee separately, for each post.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the notice, the University reserves the right to conduct a written test, skill test, interview, or any combination thereof. Only shortlisted candidates, based on prescribed qualifications, experience, suitability, and other relevant criteria, will be called for the selection process. Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for the written test/interview, and the University's decision on all selection matters is final. No further breakup of the exam pattern or syllabus has been provided in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Original certificates and testimonials for educational qualification and experience. Valid photo identity proof. Proof of application fee payment (UTR/Transaction Reference Number). Shortlisted candidates must produce these documents for verification at the time of the written test/interview, or as required by the University.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31.08.2026. Applications received after this date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Nalanda University Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies across 7 posts: Librarian (1), Deputy Librarian (1), Assistant Registrar (1), Assistant Engineer-Electrical (1), Senior Assistant (1), Library Assistant (2), and Assistant (2).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- per post, payable online to the University's HDFC Bank account, with the UTR/Transaction Reference Number mentioned in the application form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an age limit for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for these posts. This information is not available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Librarian post at Nalanda University?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, a Ph.D. in a related field, and a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience (including at least 3 years as Deputy Librarian/Additional Librarian) is required.

faq.question: Q6. Is Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 a permanent or contract-based appointment?
faq.answer: All the advertised Non-Teaching posts are on a contract basis, and selected candidates will need to execute an Employment Contract with the University.

faq.question: Q7. Can government employees apply for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates serving in Central Universities, State Universities, Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, or other Government-funded Institutions may apply on Deputation or Lien, subject to their parent organization's applicable rules.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post in Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form, along with a separate application fee, for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written test or interview for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The University reserves the right to conduct a written test, skill test, interview, or a combination of these. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process, and no TA/DA is admissible for appearing in it.
